experimental.advancedCommandsHint: Unlocks Orbit and Land at point in the map command popup (the popup defaults to Move only). Also enables the optional Lua script installer for flight controllers that lack native CIRCLE mode - ArduDeck can write a small script to the FC's SD card after explicit consent and source-code preview.

graphics.cpuWarning: The GPU is not being used, so the map and instruments are being drawn by the CPU. On a laptop or tablet that is the difference between smooth and unusable.
graphics.defaultTip: Whatever Chromium decides on its own.
graphics.forceOnTip: Override the driver blocklist and use the GPU. The right answer on almost every machine.
graphics.offTip: Draw everything on the CPU. Only for a driver that crashes.
graphics.restart: Restart ArduDeck for this to take effect.
graphics.restartHint: Chromium reads this before the first window opens, so a change needs a restart. If a launch never finishes painting, ArduDeck drops back to Default by itself.
graphics.title: Graphics
graphics.updateRateHint: ArduDeck measures how well this machine keeps up and thins the repaint when it cannot. The link rate and the recorded data never change, only how often the screen is redrawn.

mavlink.sysidHint: The MAVLink system id this station transmits as (1 to 255, default 255). Give each station on a shared link its own id, or parameter and mission transfers interleave between stations.
